rows.label: Social tax (sotsiaalmaks), paid on top by the employer
Unemployment insurance (employer), paid on top by the employer

notes: Verification (official-example): Checked against an official worked example. The golden tests reproduce the Estonian Tax and Customs Board's (EMTA) 2026 worked payroll examples for a 2,100-euro and a 600-euro monthly wage to the cent. https://emta.ee/node/330/chapter/13288/pdf https://emta.ee/node/330/chapter/13291/pdf
Salary paid monthly in 12 equal payments (no statutory 13th month in Estonia).
One employer, who applies the basic exemption (maksuvaba tulu) on your written application.
Annual figures for a salary paid evenly over the year; the social tax minimum base applies in every month (the employer who applies the basic exemption pays it).
Income tax is the annual amount; any exemption unused in a month is settled on the annual return.

Not modelled: Third-pillar pension, training cost and donation deductions on the annual return; Several employers, and the exceptions to the social tax minimum (part-time disabled workers, parents on leave …); Fringe benefits and board member fees.
